sections.heading: Neural Layer Matrices & Activations Practice Exercises

questions.q: A fully-connected dense layer maps an input \( \mathbf{x} \in \mathbb{R}^{10} \) to \( \mathbf{y} \in \mathbb{R}^{5} \) using \( \mathbf{y} = \mathbf{W}\mathbf{x} + \mathbf{b} \). How many total learnable parameters are in this layer?
questions.answer: The weight matrix \( \mathbf{W} \) has shape \( 5 \times 10 \), giving \( 50 \) weights. The bias vector \( \mathbf{b} \) has \( 5 \) parameters. Total = \( 50 + 5 = 55 \).

questions.q: Evaluate the output of the standard ReLU activation function \( f(z) = \max(0, z) \) for inputs \( z_1 = -2 \) and \( z_2 = 3 \).
questions.answer: By definition of the Rectified Linear Unit: \( \text{ReLU}(z) = z \) if \( z > 0 \), and \( 0 \) if \( z \le 0 \). Thus \( f(-2) = 0 \) and \( f(3) = 3 \).
